business_rules: Manages cart calculations, tiered customer discount rules, tax estimations, and checkout validation.
Customers belong to specific defined tiers determining discount applicability.

functions.purpose: Computes total cart price incorporating customer tier discounts and tax estimations.
Validates cart items, pricing rules, and checkout parameters prior to order confirmation.

business_rules: Generate notifications when a user is assigned a work item or mentioned in a comment.
Internal bookkeeping database changes must not generate user notifications.
Email delivery failures must not roll back underlying work item assignments or mentions.
Avoid duplicate notifications when retrying operations.
Notification list must distinguish unread items from read items without deleting read notifications.

functions.signature: create_notification(user_id: str, event_type: str, payload: dict) -> str
functions.purpose: Generates an in-app notification for relevant work item updates or user mentions.
Updates notification status to read without deleting it from the notification history.

business_rules: Attachments must strictly adhere to the access control rules of their associated work item.
Knowledge of a storage identifier alone must not grant download or view access.
File downloads must be authorized independently from the work item page view.
Unsupported preview file formats must be provided as standard downloadable content.

functions.purpose: Verifies user access permissions for the target work item and yields a secure download token.

business_rules: Dashboard must summarize active projects and assigned work items for the current user.
Completed and archived work must not dominate the default dashboard view.
A user with no assigned work must be presented with a helpful empty state rather than an error.
Dashboard counts must be derived dynamically from accessible current data.
Timestamps and date-oriented information must consider the organization timezone.

functions.purpose: Fetches aggregated count of active work items and user attention points.

business_rules: Records significant actions including project creation, ownership changes, assignment updates, and status changes.
Activities must include actor references whenever identifiable human interactions occur.
Internal operational events such as cache refreshes or search re-indexing must not be recorded as activity.

functions.signature: log_activity(event_type: str, actor_id: str, target_id: str, metadata: dict) -> None
functions.purpose: Appends a new immutable activity log entry with consistent timestamping.
